editorial.blurb: Calle De Sabores serves vibrant, authentic Colombian cuisine with generous portions and genuine warmth that makes first-timers feel like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for recommendations on what to order—the staff excels at guiding diners new to Colombian food, and don't miss the soursop juice pairing.

topDishes.note: A standout that reviewers rave about repeatedly, fresh and gluten-free
Terrific as an appetizer, delicious and satisfying
